assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE isolated front-facing shield sprite for a dark cyberpunk occult roguelike, no character. Supporting reference image: existing 32-pixel human game sprites, ONLY to match coarse pixel scale and industrial metal palette; do not reproduce any character or text. Candidate EQ-S01: compact solid symmetric trapezoid shield, clipped upper corners and gently tapered lower half; graphite black steel outer rim, one broad ivory central vertical plate, two dark side plates. Flat orthographic face viewed straight on, zero tilt, zero perspective, centered shield, fully solid central area because the center will cover the character's hand. Industrial utilitarian construction. A bold simple silhouette, no fine detailing: target a logical sprite only about 10 pixels wide and 14 pixels high, rendered as large perfectly square nearest-neighbor pixels on the output canvas. Outline roughly one logical pixel, only 2-3 values per material. Light from top-left. Transparent background with transparent corners outside shield. Shield only; no hands, arms, grip protrusion, floor, cast shadow, glow, particles, text, numbers, logos or watermark. No pink. Generous transparent margin; artwork must not touch canvas edges. This is a low-resolution game sprite, not a painted illustration or 3D product render.
